name: Vounce AI
author: Vounce AI

sections.description:
With Vounce AI’s landing page plugin for WordPress, marketers can create fully customized landing pages for
their campaigns and publish them to their existing WordPress sites.

To publish landing pages on your WordPress website:

  1. Build your landing page in Vounce AI, the landing page builder
  2. Publish your page to WordPress using this very plugin
  3. Manage all your WordPress landing pages through the plugin’s interface
  4. Edit and update all your landing pages from Vounce AI’s page builder. They will automatically get updated on your WordPress site

Vounce AI allows you to customize your landing pages to match your brand perfectly. The WYSIWYG builder allows
for quick and easy page editing. With the Vounce AI WordPress Landing Page Plugin, you can launch your landing
page on your own domain without ever talking to I.T. Try it for a month for free!

More than 10,000 digital marketers use Vounce AI. Some of the features they love the most include:

  • Publish pages to your WordPress domain
  • A team of Customer Success coaches that are easy to reach when you need help
  • 80+ free templates (plus more on ThemeForest)
  • Complete customizability of the desktop and mobile layouts
  • Built in A/B testing features
  • Integrations with the tools marketers use – MailChimp, SalesForce, Hubspot & more
  • Easy Google Analytics tagging & event tracking
  • Plus much more

External Services

This plugin connects to Vounce AI services.

It sends:
– Domain name
– Authorization information
– Project identifiers

Data is sent:
– During authorization
– When refreshing project data
– When retrieving project content

sections.installation:
Our plugin requires the following setup for the WordPress Server:
– cURL 7.34.0+
– OpenSSL 1.0.1+

We recommend at least PHP 8.0.

  1. Create a WordPress domain in Vounce AI
  2. Install this plugin through the WordPress store
  3. Activate this plugin after installation completes

OR

  1. Create a WordPress domain in Vounce AI
  2. Upload the zip file via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Activate this plugin after installation completes
sections.faq:
Do I need an Vounce AI account?

Yes. You need to sign up for Vounce AI in order to publish pages. To publish Vounce AI Pages to your
Vounce AI site, you will need to add a WordPress domain in Vounce AI. For example, if you WordPress
site is available at www.example.com, you will need to add www.example.com and publish pages in
Vounce AI to that domain for them to be visible on your WordPress site.

Do I need to log in to Vounce AI?

Yes, after installing and activating this plugin, you will need to go “Vounce AI Pages” in the admin
section and click “Authorize With Vounce AI.” You will then be sent to Vounce AI where you need to
log in. You must log in as an Vounce AI user that has access to the Client that has the current
domain in Vounce AI, or you will need to authorize again as an authorized user before the plugin
will function.

Does this plugin fetch any data from Vounce AI?

Yes, this plugin will pull information from Vounce AI’s servers regarding which pages you have
published from Vounce AI to your WordPress site. Any pages that you have published to your WordPress
site in Vounce AI will be fetched from Vounce AI’s servers and displayed on your WordPress site.
If you have a page published in Vounce AI and are using the same URL for a WordPress Page, the
Vounce AI page will be displayed, not the WordPress page.

Does this plugin send any data to Vounce AI?

The plugin sends some information along with each request to Vounce AI’s servers, containing the
version number of the plugin and of some system components, to help us diagnose issues and to track
version usage. It also has an optional “debug” mode which will send diagnostic information to
Vounce AI when switched on. This feature is disabled when you install the plugin. An Vounce AI
Customer Success Coach may request that you turn the debug feature on if you are experiencing issues
with the plugin to help track down the issue.

Vounce AI Pages are loading, but my conversions are not being tracked

This is typically caused by caching responses which affects how users are assigned unique identifiers.
You should add a rule to your cache to avoid caching Vounce AI Pages which have the HTTP header “X-vounceai-Plugin”.
